name: NoneBot Exporter
description: Exports a configured MailFlow instance as a NoneBot2 plugin
author: MailFlow community
readme:
## NoneBot Exporter

Registers the `nonebot` framework exporter: `mailflow export --framework nonebot` (or the TUI export wizard) generates a ready-to-install `nonebot-plugin-mailflow` package — pyproject, driver startup/shutdown hooks and the resolved `config.toml` — from your configured MailFlow instance.

### Features

- Embeds the resolved configuration; secrets stay `\${ENV_VAR}`-replaceable
- Declares `nonebot2` plus every enabled MailFlow plugin as dependencies
- No chat commands: the engine boots with the bot lifecycle

### Usage

```bash
uv run mailflow export --framework nonebot --output dist/nonebot_plugin_mailflow -c configs/development.toml
# or: make bot-plugin-nonebot
```

See the [bot-exporter development guide](../docs/bot-exporter.md).

### License

MIT — contributions welcome.

## mailflow-export-nonebot

注册 `nonebot` 框架导出器：`mailflow export --framework nonebot`（或 TUI 导出向导）会从你配置好的 MailFlow 实例生成一个可直接安装的 `nonebot-plugin-mailflow` 包——包含 pyproject、驱动启动/关闭钩子与解析后的 `config.toml`。

### 特性

- 内嵌解析后的配置；密钥仍可用 `\${ENV_VAR}` 占位符替换
- 自动声明 `nonebot2` 与所有已启用的 MailFlow 插件为依赖
- 不包含聊天命令：引擎随机器人生命周期启停

### 使用

```bash
uv run mailflow export --framework nonebot --output dist/nonebot_plugin_mailflow -c configs/development.toml
# 或：make bot-plugin-nonebot
```

参见[机器人导出插件开发指南](../docs/bot-exporter.md)。

### 协议

MIT — 欢迎贡献。
